title: PowerFly HZEB-LCT-10 10.54kWh Wall-Mounted Battery
summary: A higher-capacity 51.2V LiFePO4 home battery for villas, backup loads, and expandable residential solar projects.

specs.label: Cycle life
specs.value: >=6,000 cycles at cabinet level; up to 8,000 at cell level

faqs.question: How long will 10.5 kWh power my home?
faqs.answer: For a household using 8-10 kWh a day, essential circuits run 12-24 hours; full home use runs 8-12 hours, depending on load.

faqs.question: What is the expected lifespan?
faqs.answer: 6,000 cycles at cabinet level, or 15-20 years under typical residential use. Cell level is rated up to 8,000.

faqs.question: Can I add a second unit later?
faqs.answer: Yes, up to 15 units in parallel. Use matched models rather than mixing capacities in one bank.
